headline: CJ Lands Allen as Parker Pays the Quarterback Premium
verdict: CJ is the current winner, with the stronger B+ grade and a decisive roster-fit edge.
summary: This is a clean one-for-one swap with a clear difference in supplied value: Josh Allen carries a 90.6 package value, while Omarion Hampton checks in at 73.9. Parker’s B- reflects the trade’s strong lineup-impact score of 88 and a useful RB addition, but surrendering a player ranked third in search rank with a 22-point season average creates the larger value concession. CJ earns a B+ because Allen’s quarterback value, 96 roster-fit score, and 96 lineup-impact score align with a 5-9 roster that already features Jahmyr Gibbs but also has Dak Prescott. Parker gets the younger RB profile on paper, while CJ gets the headline asset. Public Enemy or not, the numbers favor CJ.
